evals.prompt: Document the C1 and C2 architecture for a small order-tracking web application from the supplied requirements. Keep the D2 files in Git.
evals.expected_output: Uses C4 system/context versus container abstraction appropriately, maintains one shared D2 model, labels assumptions, and provides reviewable sources with truthful validation status.

evals.prompt: Our existing D2/C4 design now needs an inventory service. Add it without changing unrelated diagram elements.
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing model/spec first, preserves stable IDs and unrelated files, updates affected model/views/spec/ADRs, and explains risks and impact.

evals.prompt: Draw our production deployment with AWS, Kubernetes, Redis and three databases; we have not decided on hosting, caching, or databases.
evals.expected_output: Does not fabricate approved infrastructure; distinguishes proposed choices from implemented facts, asks for required decisions or supplies a clearly labeled conceptual option rather than misleading definitive diagrams.
